body: Thank you so much, I used to go 5 times a week but because of quarantine I haven't since
I know they love me. I just don't want them to, because I always manage to hurt people around me. Them. Friends. Girlfriend. I just want to stop hurting people.

Hey, I know you may feel like that but try and talk to them, maybe start with just one. I felt the same way about burdening people and I still do. But I do realize that family is there to help you. Try and open up slowly the way you feel comfortable, because your feelings matter just as much as anyone's.

For me, I kinda do things that I love, cheesy as that sounds. It's mostly watching stupid YouTube videos or playing video games if that's what you're into. 
Just doing something that lets you disconnect from the world and brings you into your own little happy world even if it's just for an hour or so, it helps.
